messages:
emma (product): Quick sync — we need to schedule a design review for the Unified API + SDK + Console UX work. Aim is to review API surface, SDK auth flows, console UX mocks, and rollout/canary plan. Can folks mark availability or suggest a better time? Pre-read + checklist below. React with :one:/:two:/:three: or reply.

Proposed slots (next week):
1) Mon 10/26 10:00-11:00 PT (:one:)
2) Tue 10/27 15:00-16:00 PT (:two:)
3) Wed 10/28 09:00-10:00 PT (:three:)

Pre-read doc: https://drive.redwood/team/designs/unified-api-sdk-console (please add short 2-line summaries in the doc)

Pre-read checklist (copy into PRs if you like):
- Read API surface doc: endpoints + example payloads
- SDK: auth flows, error handling, pagination examples
- Console: mock screens + telemetry points
- Rollout: canary criteria, fallback plan, migration strategy
- Tests: contract tests and e2e smoke list

Sample checklist block you can copy:
```
- [ ] API endpoints reviewed (owner: diego)
- [ ] SDK auth flow + samples (owner: priya)
- [ ] Console mocks + telemetry (owner: lucas)
- [ ] Canary plan + fallback (owner: morgan)
- [ ] Contract tests ready (owner: eng-sre)
```

Diego: I can present the API surface. I prefer slot 1 or 2, lean towards 1 though. Also please add the API contract examples to the doc (I'll paste a minimal example).

emma (product): thanks — Diego pls paste example, we'll pin it in the pre-read.

Priya: I have a customer demo Mon afternoon so Mon morning is blocked for me. I can do Tue 15:00 (slot 2) or Wed morning (slot 3). I'll own the SDK auth section. Also can someone confirm whether we want the SDK examples in both JS and Python? I'd suggest just JS for first pass.

Lucas: Tue (slot 2) works best for me. I'll add console mock screenshots to the doc and note telemetry event names.

Chris: can we add a short SLO & observability checklist to pre-read? Minimal:
- latency P50/P95 targets for API calls
- error budget per release
- tracing hooks + metric names
I'll paste a small block into the doc in a sec.

Morgan: adding rollout notes — for Dedicated we need a canary that verifies latency and correctness under batching. Suggest canary gating: 1) functional contract tests pass, 2) no >10% reg increase in tail latency, 3) error rate within budget. I'll draft specifics. Also flagging that quantized model variant differs on TTL for cache — we should call out fallback behavior.

Diego: API contract example (minimal):
```http
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rw-llm-1",
  "input": "Summarize the doc",
  "max_tokens": 200
}
```
Response: 200 with `choices[]` and `usage` fields.

Priya: JS SDK example OK for first pass. I'll add a short note about token scoping and error codes.

emma (product): Based on initial reactions looks like slot 2 (Tue 15:00) has most thumbs up. If no objections I'll book for Tue. We need a volunteer to facilitate queue and keep time — Lucas, can you MC console + timekeep?

Lucas: I can MC and keep to the agenda. I'll prep a 5m mock walkthrough and 3 backstop questions to keep Q&A tight.

Chris: I'll own the SLO section during the review and answer instrumenting questions.

Morgan: I'll own rollout/canary section. Will add the Dedicated vs Hosted notes.

Priya: tagging a note — please include contract test checklist in CI: minimal contract tests should be added under eng/contract-tests/unified-api.

Diego: added API examples and small OpenAPI snippet in the doc.

emma (product): Great. Action items before Tue: everyone add their 2-line summary to the doc, owners drop any examples/snippets, and Lucas/Chris/Morgan add timeboxed slides (3-5 slides each).

sre-bot: Calendar event created: "Design Review — Unified API/SDK/Console" Tue 10/27 15:00-16:00 PT • meeting link https://meet.redwood/abc123 (created by emma)

Diego: noted — I'll also add a small diff to the SDK repo for the sample code to make it easier to run locally.

Priya: ack. I'll aim to have SDK samples and CI checklist in place by EOD Monday.

Lucas: I'll prep the mock slides and post screenshots to the doc by Monday evening.

Chris: I'll paste the SLO/observability snippet in the doc now.

emma (product): thanks everyone — see you Tue. If any blockers, reply in thread. :thumbsup:
